'''Fishing sounds''' are custom sounds that play when a catch is reeled in. The sound depends on what was caught. They were made by the community contributor Imtlx.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Fishing different items gives different sounds! (Made by Imtlx!)}}</ref>

== Mechanics ==
Each sound is an advancement with a <code>fishing_rod_hooked</code> trigger. Its reward function plays the sound to that player alone and revokes the advancement so it can fire again.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/sound_fx/1_star.mcfunction}}</ref> The sounds use the '''Jukebox/Note Blocks''' volume slider.

Sulfur Chunks from Sulfur Caves have no sound.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/junk.json}}</ref>

=== Bugs ===
The treasure sound checks the Crystal Heart for the item model <code>matcha:crystal_heart</code>, but fished Crystal Hearts use <code>matcha:heart_container</code>. A fished Crystal Heart therefore plays no sound.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/treasure.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/crystal_heart.json}}</ref>
